findings.evidence: Protocol sources (home page, README, app.js) publish no release identifier for this board; they name tasks, domains and agents but no version tag or release. The row declares version_status "published" with version "40-tasks", which requires a maintainer-published release identifier being copied. Per criterion c2, a board with no published release identifier must have version_status "snapshot" and a dated snapshot identity.
findings.repair: Change version_status to "snapshot" and set version to the dated snapshot identity (e.g., snapshot-2026-11-11) reflecting the captured methodology, or else produce evidence of an actual published release identifier to keep "published".

uncertainties: I could not execute hashes or full page retrieval; the SOURCE 1 excerpt may not contain the entire page, so the absence of a release identifier is judged from the provided excerpt only.
